```
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug.

    The title is stripped of surrounding whitespace and lowercased. Each run
    of characters outside ``a-z`` and ``0-9`` becomes a single hyphen, and
    leading or trailing hyphens are removed. Non-ASCII letters are dropped
    rather than transliterated.

    Args:
        title: The text to convert. Must be a ``str``.

    Returns:
        The slug as a ``str``. It is empty if ``title`` has no ASCII letters
        or digits.

    Raises:
        AttributeError: If ``title`` is not a string (for example, ``None``).
    """
```
